Exceptional service! Friendly staff and my dog looked amazing. Will definitely be back.
Customers service was on point
She was very friendly and gentle with Gary I’m definitely coming back

Absolutely loved the service! They were so kind, gentle, and caring with my dog. He looked amazing after his grooming and was so happy. I’m really happy with the result and will definitely be coming back! Highly recommend! ❤️🐶 …

I couldnt  be happier with the service at maya grooming, the team ate so caring and professional, they are genuinely lovely with the dogs and you can tell they really care about the animals , my dog always comes back looking and smelling amazing . Thank you and see you soon 💗 …

It is very interesting I think that my genuine review about a genuine issue was responded to by the company with a respond which claims CCTV was reviewed at the same time as saying, A. They don’t know which booking to look for B. the receptionist would never have waived the fee.

In other words, they are saying I don’t exist and I am lying. No apology just a flat rebuttal that the events ever happened. I have to say that this doesn’t surprise me at all give my experince. It is the sort of attitude that allows pets to be treated roughly and customers to be gaslighted. Extraordinary stuff! It is a shame you can’t give zero stars.

Really happy with the service! They took great care of my cat and did such a lovely job. He came home looking so clean, fluffy and fresh. The staff were very kind and gentle. Definitely recommend! 🐱💕 …

I had such a lovely experience bringing my kitten here! Everyone was so friendly, gentle and caring, and I could tell they genuinely love animals. My kitten was treated with so much patience and care.
I’m really happy with the service and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a professional and caring grooming salon. We’ll definitely be coming back!!🐱🤍

I’m so happy we found Maya Grooming! ❤️

My Chow Chow, chino, was extremely nervous about grooming because of a very bad experience at a previous grooming salon. Unfortunately, he was treated roughly there and was slapped, which left him scared and very anxious about being groomed.

Since we started bringing chino to Maya Grooming, I’ve seen such a lovely change in him. With every visit, he gets better and better and seems much more comfortable and trusting. The team is so patient, gentle and understanding with him, and that means so much to us.

Chow Chows can be challenging to groom, especially when they’ve had a stressful experience in the past, so I really appreciate the care, patience and kindness they show chino. I feel much more relaxed knowing he is in good hands.

Thank you so much, Maya Grooming, for taking such good care of Sam and helping him feel safe again. ❤️ Highly recommended!

We have used this place a few times before under a different name, and have always been quite happy with it. Today, our dog didn't want to enter the shop and pulled back hard on the lead when we got near the door. After an hour, I returned to collect the dog, was let in, and was immediately confronted with a groomer yanking our spaniel across the grooming bench by the ear as she tried to pull away while being hair-dried. I couldn't believe my eyes.

I protested to the receptionist, who denied that our dog had been mishandled. I reassured her that he had not been hallucinating. I asked for the dog to be returned and to pay. The receptionist pulled out her phone to attempt to show me a video of the grooming. I said it was not required, as I was very sure of what I had just witnessed.

It was incredibly upsetting to see our family pet treated so roughly in front of my eyes. As I was protesting to the receptionist - who continued to deny there was anything wrong - the groomer did the same thing again! Yanking our poor spaniel back across the counter by roughly her ear. I was flabbergasted and pointed to the issue again. I asked that the dog be returned immediately and asked to pay. The receptionist declined to take payment. I left shocked and very cross that a business that claims to care about animals can handle them in such an appalling way.

No wonder the dog didn't want to go back there. We won't be going back again. Shocking.

“I’m so happy with Ocean’s grooming! He looks absolutely adorable, and you can really tell how much care and attention was given to him. He came home looking fresh, fluffy, and beautifully groomed. Thank you so much for taking such good care of my little boy. We really appreciate it and will definitely be coming back!” 🐶❤️
Always amazingly kind and friendly towards my dog and they do a brilliant groom.
Lovely experience from start to finish. My dog came out looking and smelling amazing. The staff were so friendly and caring, and I’m really happy with the result. Would definitely recommend!
Just wanted to say a HUGE thank you for doing such a beautiful groom on Tom and for flagging that he had an ear infection. Thanks to you the vet said we caught it early and he got treated ♥️
Very friendly and experienced for sure plus fair price

We asked the groomer if she could groom our long haired cat with a knotty underside of very fine fur. She said yes. Our cat had had 2 gabapentin in advance to calm him down. I don't want to go into details of the event. Suffice to say that we were called in to help restrain the cat along with the grooming assistant. I don't know who was more traumatised, us or the cat. However the underside shaving, nails, paws and some top combing were successfully completed.
They may perhaps do dogs well , but I cannot recommend them for a long haired cat

We’re so happy with our cat Julep’s groom! She is a very fluffy girl and I’m so happy we finally found someone who listened and gave her exactly the look we wanted. She’s neatly trimmed, clean, and looks great. Also much cooler in this hot weather while still keeping her fluffy style. Thank you so much, we’ll definitely be back!

Maya Grooming has been looking after Benji for years now, and I honestly wouldn’t trust anyone else with him. From day one, they’ve treated him like one of their own, and you can tell they genuinely care about every dog that walks through their doors.

Benji actually gets excited when it’s time for his groom, which says everything. He always comes home looking amazing, smelling incredible, and you can see the care and attention that’s gone into every detail.

What really sets Maya Grooming apart is how attentive they are to his sensitive skin and the seasonal allergies he gets every year. They always take the time to make sure he’s comfortable and use the right products to keep his skin as calm as possible. That level of care and knowledge gives us complete peace of mind.

They also offer such a wide range of services, all at really reasonable prices, which is hard to find these days. The team are friendly, professional, reliable, and consistently go above and beyond every single visit.

I genuinely couldn’t recommend Maya Grooming more highly. If you’re looking for groomers who truly love what they do and will treat your dog like family, this is the place. Thank you for always taking such amazing care of my boy Benji!
Best groomers for my toy poodle. They were especially good at teeth cleaning which most groomers find impossible to do
I love Maya Grooming! They have taken care of Chase for a year and he loves them!  They are very attentive and caring. They have gone above and beyond in how they care for him!!
Great groomers! Lovely and friendly and my dog always comes out looking so handsome, smelling super yummy and with the best haircut of any groomers I’ve tried. They are well priced too
Maya grooming is always our go to grooming place in West Hampstead. Excellent work and very nice attitude for our dog (Bruno). Very easy to book and communicate with. Thank you!!
Complete lack of understanding of the expected result. I paid for a full haircut, but only a trim and bath were performed. Waste of time and money. 🙁 …

I also appreciated the great communication and professional service throughout. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a trustworthy and talented dog groomer!

Amazing returning customer , i have been going there for few years now and always satisfied with the service and friendly staff and the level of professionalism and also the love for our dogs .

Fantastic service from start to finish. The groom was done beautifully clean lines, soft coat, and the teddy bear look was perfect. Staff were friendly and clearly experienced. My dog was comfortable the whole time. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a reliable groomer.

Was very pleased with the service we received
Thank you

Amazing groomers thank you so much! Definitely returning again xx

had a wonderful experience at Maya Grooming with my cats Alfie and Lucky. The service was excellent from start to finish. The groomers were extremely professional, gentle, and clearly very experienced with cats. They handled Alfie and Lucky with so much care and patience, which really put me at ease.

The team was also very kind, helpful, and attentive, taking the time to explain everything and making sure my cats were comfortable throughout the process. Alfie and Lucky came back looking clean, well groomed, and relaxed. I couldn’t be happier with the level of care they received.

I highly recommend Maya Grooming to anyone looking for a trustworthy and professional grooming service
